standard-dialogue.npc: Oh, nilsal, fellow traveller. You don't see many other people out here.

standard-dialogue.player: Hello there! Where are you heading to?

standard-dialogue.npc: The Proudspire of course! I'm walking the Pilgrim Path.

steps.npc: It is a sacred pilgrimage between the Teomat and the Proudspire. I do it every year, as do many others.
The hardest part is the last bit: Reaching the summit of the Proudspire. Only upon touching the obelisk at the top is your journey complete.

steps.player: I see. Well good luck with your journey.

steps.npc: Thank you, traveller. May the sun light your way.
Thank you, traveller. May the sun light your way.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogues.npc: Nilsal to you once more, fellow traveller.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogues.player: Hello again! How are things going?

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogues.npc: I'm still on route to the Proudspire, but I'm having a bit of a break to enjoy the scenery. Walking the Pilgrim Path can be long and arduous.
